adjudication: Each barcode-first-only molecule contains one exact whitelist-valid cassette and at least one additional exact-linker cassette with an invalid terminal barcode. The anchor-first pattern is ambiguous under one-best before its body whitelist guard is evaluated.
decision: Retain one-best. The four-read exclusion is conservative and documented; all mode is rejected because it emits duplicate FASTQ records and changes the accepted-ID set.
